verdict.rationale: Working Copy's core git feature set (commit, checkout old version, undo, amend, delete/squash commits, commit graph, tags, stash) directly supports versioning, reviewing and rolling back changes, and it explicitly extends this to AI-driven work via the Repository Agent, which commits/pulls/pushes on your behalf, and AI-suggested commit messages — meaning agent automations are captured as reviewable, revertible git history. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence that Repository Agent actions are specifically rolled back in practice, and no dedicated docs tying rollback UI directly to agent-generated automations rather than manual edits.
